    • components/code-comment
    • TpCodeComment

    Class TpCodeComment

    associates an ordered annotation list with numbered comments in a code editor.

    Example

    <tp-code-editor id="commented-function" language="typescript">
      <script type="tp/typescript">
        function f(x: number): number {
          if (x > 0) { return 2 * x; } // <1>
          else { return 4 * x; } // <2>
        }
      </script>
    </tp-code-editor>
    <tp-code-comment for="commented-function">
      <ol>
        <li>Positive values are doubled.</li>
        <li>Zero and negative values are multiplied by four.</li>
      </ol>
    </tp-code-comment>

    Tagname

    tp-code-comment

    Attr

    for = "" - Exact ID, without #, of the tp-code-editor to annotate.

    Attr

    open = false - Show the explanation list; code markers and tooltips remain available when absent.

    Accessibility

    Preserves the ordered-list semantics and names each code marker by its number.
